title: hydrochloric — hypocritical

sentences.sentence: We now dissolve everything in a mixture of hydrochloric acid at 35% and chlorine bleach (sodium hypochlorite) at 5%, in a proportion of 2 to 1.
sentences.translation: 现在我们用35%的盐酸和5%的漂白剂（次氯酸钠）把所有金属溶解。 盐酸和次氯酸钠的比例为2：1。

translations.translation: 水力发电的；水电治疗的

sentences.sentence: a huge hydroelectric power station
sentences.translation: 大型水力发电站

sentences.sentence: The church is now an ominous symbol of energy shortages in the country, which gets around 68 percent of its power from hydroelectricity, Reuters reported.
sentences.translation: 据路透社报道，这座教堂现在成为象征国家能源短缺的不祥之物，在这个国家，约有68%的电力来自于水力发电。

sentences.sentence: The sharp increase of water flow to ramp up hydroelectricity caused severe stress to the nation's largest lake, Lake Sevan, where efforts at ecological restoration are a continuing battle.
sentences.translation: 水流量迅猛增加，以加速水力发电，这给这个国家最大的湖泊斯旺湖造成了严重的压力，生态恢复仍旧是一场持久战。

phrases.translation: 硫酸氢盐；氢硫酸根离子

sentences.sentence: Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.
sentences.translation: 水含有氢和氧。

sentences.sentence: Water can be reduced to oxygen and hydrogen by electrolysis.
sentences.translation: 水通过电解可以分解为氧和氢。

sentences.sentence: The first bubbles to escape from the liquid are a mixture of air and hydrogen.
sentences.translation: 从该液体中最先逸出的气泡是空气和氢的混合物。

sentences.sentence: Treated with methanol and potassium hydroxide, also known as lye, the vegetable oil molecules break down.
sentences.translation: 植物油分子经过甲醇和钾的氢氧化物、也被称作灰汁的处理后就被分解。

sentences.sentence: the importance of personal hygiene
sentences.translation: 个人卫生的重要性

sentences.sentence: a food hygiene training course
sentences.translation: 食品卫生培训课程

sentences.sentence: He liked to sing hymns as he worked.
sentences.translation: 他工作时喜欢唱赞美诗。

phrases.translation: 媒体炒作（媒体制造的潮流泡沫）

sentences.sentence: Some experts are concerned that the new drug won’t live up to all the hype.
sentences.translation: 一些专家担心这种新药并不像宣传中那么好。

sentences.sentence: Despite the media hype , I found the film very disappointing.
sentences.translation: 尽管媒体大肆炒作，我还是觉得这部影片很让人失望。

translations.translation: 极度活跃的；活动过度的

sentences.sentence: His research was used in planning treatments for hyperactive children.
sentences.translation: 他的研究被用来为患有多动症的儿童设计治疗方案。

sentences.sentence: He's as big a geek as Zuckerberg, but of a different type: the hypercritical, even sometimes nasty type.
sentences.translation: 他与扎克伯格一样，是个超级极客，只不过是另一种类型的：他吹毛求疵，有时甚至令人讨厌。

sentences.sentence: I know it's time to grow up, stop being hypercritical and just enter the dating pool, with all its clichés and absolute disappointments.
sentences.translation: 我知道，是时候要长大了，我该停止吹毛求疵，去约会，不管它有多老套，有多让人失望。

phrases.translation: 原发性高血压；特发性高血压
肺动脉高血压；肺动脉血压过高；肺动脉高压症

sentences.sentence: Because she included the hyphen (-), nothing else is required; because 1=1 is always true, she will be able to log in successfully.
sentences.translation: 由于她包含了连字号（-），所以任何其他东西都不需要；由于 1=1 总是为真，所以她将能够成功登录。

sentences.sentence: It should be used primarily to hyphenate words in justified type.
sentences.translation: 他应该使用于字母断行连接时。

sentences.sentence: I feel shame and guilt telling my female friends who chose to keep their last names or hyphenate.
sentences.translation: 和那些保留了自己的姓或使用了连字符的女友们谈起时，我会觉得内疚、没面子。

sentences.sentence: Bevin is now an adult and has re-lived her birth experience under hypnosis.
sentences.translation: 贝文现在已是成年人，在催眠状态下，她再次经历了出生过程。

translations.translation: 催眠的，催眠术的；易于催眠的

sentences.sentence: a hypnotic trance
sentences.translation: 催眠后的恍惚状态

sentences.sentence: Dulcy also saw a psychiatrist who used hypnotism to help her deal with her fear.
sentences.translation: 达尔茜还去看了精神科医生，那医生使用催眠术帮她消除恐惧感。

sentences.sentence: It would be sheer hypocrisy to pray for success, since I’ve never believed in God.
sentences.translation: 我从不相信上帝，因此为获成功而祈祷是纯粹的虚伪之举。

sentences.sentence: The magazine wrongly suggested he was a liar and a hypocrite.
sentences.translation: 该杂志错误地暗示他是个骗子和伪君子。

sentences.sentence: It would be hypocritical to say I travel at 70 mph simply because that is the law.
sentences.translation: 如果仅仅因为法律规定的时速是70英里我就说自己的行驶时速是70英里，那就太虚伪了。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 313 单元

hydrochloric
音标：英 /,haɪdrəʊ'klɒrɪk/  美 /,haɪdrə'klorɪk/
adj. 氯化氢的，盐酸的
短语：hydrochloric acid — 盐酸
短语：dilute hydrochloric acid — 稀盐酸
短语：concentrated hydrochloric acid — 浓盐酸；高浓度盐酸
例句：We now dissolve everything in a mixture of hydrochloric acid at 35% and chlorine bleach (sodium hypochlorite) at 5%, in a proportion of 2 to 1.
现在我们用35%的盐酸和5%的漂白剂（次氯酸钠）把所有金属溶解。 盐酸和次氯酸钠的比例为2：1。

hydroelectric
音标：英 /haɪdrəʊɪ'lektrɪk/  美 /,haɪdroɪ'lɛktrɪk/
adj. 水力发电的；水电治疗的
短语：hydroelectric power — 水力发电；水电力
短语：hydroelectric station — 水力发电站
短语：hydroelectric power station — 水电站；水力发电厂
短语：hydroelectric generator — 水力发电机
例句：a huge hydroelectric power station
大型水力发电站

hydroelectricity
音标：美 /,haɪdroɪ,lɛk'trɪsəti/
n. 水力电气
例句：The church is now an ominous symbol of energy shortages in the country, which gets around 68 percent of its power from hydroelectricity, Reuters reported.
据路透社报道，这座教堂现在成为象征国家能源短缺的不祥之物，在这个国家，约有68%的电力来自于水力发电。
例句：The sharp increase of water flow to ramp up hydroelectricity caused severe stress to the nation's largest lake, Lake Sevan, where efforts at ecological restoration are a continuing battle.
水流量迅猛增加，以加速水力发电，这给这个国家最大的湖泊斯旺湖造成了严重的压力，生态恢复仍旧是一场持久战。

hydrogen
音标：英 /'haɪdrədʒ(ə)n/  美 /'haɪdrədʒən/
n. [化学] 氢
短语：hydrogen peroxide — 过氧化氢
短语：hydrogen production — 制氢
短语：hydrogen sulfide — 硫化氢
短语：hydrogen bond — [化]氢键
短语：hydrogen content — 氢含量
短语：hydrogen chloride — 氯化氢；氢氟酸
短语：hydrogen bonding — 氢键；氢键结合
短语：hydrogen atom — 氢原子
短语：hydrogen embrittlement — [材料学]氢脆
短语：hydrogen phosphate — 磷酸氢盐
短语：hydrogen sulphide — 硫化氢
短语：hydrogen fluoride — 氟化氢
短语：hydrogen bomb — 氢弹
短语：calcium hydrogen phosphate — 磷酸氢钙
短语：hydrogen carbonate — [化]碳酸氢盐
短语：hydrogen ion — 氢离子
短语：hydrogen sulfate — 硫酸氢盐；氢硫酸根离子
短语：atomic hydrogen — 原子氢
短语：ammonium hydrogen carbonate — [化]碳酸氢铵
短语：sulfureted hydrogen — [化]硫化氢
例句：Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.
水含有氢和氧。
例句：Water can be reduced to oxygen and hydrogen by electrolysis.
水通过电解可以分解为氧和氢。
例句：The first bubbles to escape from the liquid are a mixture of air and hydrogen.
从该液体中最先逸出的气泡是空气和氢的混合物。

hydroxide
音标：英 /haɪ'drɒksaɪd/  美 /haɪ'drɑksaɪd/
n. [无化] 氢氧化物；羟化物
短语：sodium hydroxide — n. [化]氢氧化钠
短语：magnesium hydroxide — [化]氢氧化镁
短语：calcium hydroxide — 氢氧化钙；氢化钙
短语：aluminum hydroxide — 氢氧化铝
短语：aluminium hydroxide — [化]氢氧化铝
短语：potassium hydroxide — [化]氢氧化钾
短语：ammonium hydroxide — n. [化]氢氧化铵
短语：barium hydroxide — 氢氧化钡
短语：nickel hydroxide — 氢氧化镍
短语：lithium hydroxide — 氢氧化锂
短语：ferric hydroxide — 氢氧化铁
短语：zirconium hydroxide — [化]氢氧化锆
短语：cerium hydroxide — 氢氧化铈
例句：Treated with methanol and potassium hydroxide, also known as lye, the vegetable oil molecules break down.
植物油分子经过甲醇和钾的氢氧化物、也被称作灰汁的处理后就被分解。

hygiene
音标：英 /'haɪdʒiːn/  美 /'haɪdʒin/
n. 卫生；卫生学；保健法
短语：food hygiene — 食品卫生学
短语：personal hygiene — 个人卫生
短语：oral hygiene — 口腔卫生
短语：industrial hygiene — 工业卫生；劳动卫生
短语：dental hygiene — 牙齿卫生；口腔卫生学
短语：mental hygiene — 心理卫生；心理卫生学
短语：nutrition and food hygiene — 营养与食品卫生学
短语：hygiene education — 卫生教育；保健教育
短语：hygiene factor — 保健因素
例句：the importance of personal hygiene
个人卫生的重要性
例句：a food hygiene training course
食品卫生培训课程

hymn
音标：英 /hɪm/  美 /hɪm/
n. 赞美诗；圣歌；欢乐的歌
v. 唱赞美歌
例句：He liked to sing hymns as he worked.
他工作时喜欢唱赞美诗。

hype
音标：英 /haɪp/  美 /haɪp/
n. 大肆宣传；皮下注射
v. 大肆宣传；使…兴奋
短语：media hype — 媒体炒作（媒体制造的潮流泡沫）
例句：Some experts are concerned that the new drug won’t live up to all the hype.
一些专家担心这种新药并不像宣传中那么好。
例句：Despite the media hype , I found the film very disappointing.
尽管媒体大肆炒作，我还是觉得这部影片很让人失望。

hyperactive
音标：英 /haɪpər'æktɪv/  美 /,haɪpɚ'æktɪv/
adj. 极度活跃的；活动过度的
例句：His research was used in planning treatments for hyperactive children.
他的研究被用来为患有多动症的儿童设计治疗方案。

hypercritical
音标：英 /haɪpə'krɪtɪk(ə)l/  美 /'haɪpɚ'krɪtɪkl/
adj. 吹毛求疵的，苛评的
例句：He's as big a geek as Zuckerberg, but of a different type: the hypercritical, even sometimes nasty type.
他与扎克伯格一样，是个超级极客，只不过是另一种类型的：他吹毛求疵，有时甚至令人讨厌。
例句：I know it's time to grow up, stop being hypercritical and just enter the dating pool, with all its clichés and absolute disappointments.
我知道，是时候要长大了，我该停止吹毛求疵，去约会，不管它有多老套，有多让人失望。

hypermarket
音标：英 /'haɪpəmɑːkɪt/  美 /'haɪpɚmɑrkɪt/
n. 大规模超级市场

hypertension
音标：英 /haɪpə'tenʃ(ə)n/  美 /,haɪpɚ'tɛnʃən/
n. 高血压；过度紧张
短语：portal hypertension — 门静脉血压过高
短语：essential hypertension — 原发性高血压；特发性高血压
短语：pulmonary hypertension — 肺动脉高血压；肺动脉血压过高；肺动脉高压症
短语：primary hypertension — 原发性高血压
短语：renovascular hypertension — 肾血管性高血压
短语：malignant hypertension — 恶性高血压
短语：secondary hypertension — 继发性高血压

hyphen
音标：英 /'haɪf(ə)n/  美 /'haɪfn/
v. 以连字号连接
n. 连字号
例句：Because she included the hyphen (-), nothing else is required; because 1=1 is always true, she will be able to log in successfully.
由于她包含了连字号（-），所以任何其他东西都不需要；由于 1=1 总是为真，所以她将能够成功登录。

hyphenate
音标：英 /'haɪfəneɪt/  美 /'haifəneit/
v. 用连字符号连接
n. 归化的美国公民
例句：It should be used primarily to hyphenate words in justified type.
他应该使用于字母断行连接时。
例句：I feel shame and guilt telling my female friends who chose to keep their last names or hyphenate.
和那些保留了自己的姓或使用了连字符的女友们谈起时，我会觉得内疚、没面子。

hypnosis
音标：英 /hɪp'nəʊsɪs/  美 /hɪp'nosɪs/
n. 催眠；催眠状态
例句：Bevin is now an adult and has re-lived her birth experience under hypnosis.
贝文现在已是成年人，在催眠状态下，她再次经历了出生过程。

hypnotic
音标：英 /hɪp'nɒtɪk/  美 /hɪp'nɑtɪk/
adj. 催眠的，催眠术的；易于催眠的
n. 安眠药；催眠状态的人
例句：a hypnotic trance
催眠后的恍惚状态

hypnotism
音标：英 /'hɪpnətɪz(ə)m/  美 /'hɪpnətɪzəm/
n. 催眠术；催眠状态
例句：Dulcy also saw a psychiatrist who used hypnotism to help her deal with her fear.
达尔茜还去看了精神科医生，那医生使用催眠术帮她消除恐惧感。

hypocrisy
音标：英 /hɪ'pɒkrɪsɪ/  美 /hɪ'pɑkrəsi/
n. 虚伪；伪善
例句：It would be sheer hypocrisy to pray for success, since I’ve never believed in God.
我从不相信上帝，因此为获成功而祈祷是纯粹的虚伪之举。

hypocrite
音标：英 /'hɪpəkrɪt/  美 /'hɪpə'krɪt/
n. 伪君子；伪善者
例句：The magazine wrongly suggested he was a liar and a hypocrite.
该杂志错误地暗示他是个骗子和伪君子。

hypocritical
音标：英 /,hɪpə'krɪtɪkl/  美 /,hɪpə'krɪtɪkl/
adj. 虚伪的；伪善的
例句：It would be hypocritical to say I travel at 70 mph simply because that is the law.
如果仅仅因为法律规定的时速是70英里我就说自己的行驶时速是70英里，那就太虚伪了。
